name: word-in-gpt
description: View and edit .docx files together with chat.

interface.longDescription: Open DOCX documents in a page-layout editor. Read, search, and rewrite text with chat while keeping existing styles. Apply formatting, edit tables, and adjust page layout. Highlight text and choose Add to chat. Review comments alongside the document. Download an edited copy of an uploaded attachment. Host-managed files save through the host when writing is permitted.
defaultPrompt: Tighten the wording in the open document
Add a summary table to the open document

positive.description: In ChatGPT web and the ChatGPT mobile app, attach an unchanged copy of review.docx from the fixture URL. It contains Quarterly review and Revenue increased this quarter. Open the attachment with Word in Chat and wait for Chat connected. Start each case in a fresh chat with a fresh attachment.
positive.prompt: Open review.docx in Word in Chat so I can edit it.
positive.expected_behavior: Call open_word_document with ChatGPT's file object: download_url and file_id, plus optional file_name and mime_type. The result returns editorSessionId directly; use that ID to call word_document_inspect with kind context and confirm both fixture paragraphs. The editor displays Quarterly review and Revenue increased this quarter., Chat connected, and Download DOCX.

positive.description: In ChatGPT web and the ChatGPT mobile app, attach an unchanged copy of review.docx from the fixture URL. It contains Quarterly review and Revenue increased this quarter. Open the attachment with Word in Chat and wait for Chat connected. Start each case in a fresh chat with a fresh attachment.
positive.prompt: Summarize the open document in one sentence.
positive.expected_behavior: Call word_document_inspect with kind context and the session ID for review.docx. Summarize the quarterly review and increased revenue using the returned text. File content stays unchanged.

positive.description: In ChatGPT web and the ChatGPT mobile app, attach an unchanged copy of review.docx from the fixture URL. It contains Quarterly review and Revenue increased this quarter. positive.prompt: Find every occurrence of Revenue in the open document.
positive.expected_behavior: Call word_document_inspect with kind search, query Revenue, and the current session ID. Report the one matching paragraph using the returned references. File content stays unchanged.

positive.description: In ChatGPT web and the ChatGPT mobile app, attach an unchanged copy of review.docx from the fixture URL. It contains Quarterly review and Revenue increased this quarter. Open the attachment with Word in Chat and wait for Chat connected. Start each case in a fresh chat with a fresh attachment.
positive.prompt: Change Revenue increased this quarter. to Revenue grew this quarter. Keep the existing formatting.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the body with word_document_project in text mode. Apply word_document_patch in text mode using its revision and window. Only the revenue paragraph becomes Revenue grew this quarter. The heading style and paragraph/run formatting remain intact. The tool reports Edited copy ready to download. Choose Download DOCX and reopen the exported file to verify the text and formatting.

positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the document and call word_document_format_paragraph with align center, the heading blockRef, the observed revision, and editorSessionId. Confirm the centered heading in the panel. Download DOCX and reopen it to verify paragraph alignment center, unchanged text, and Heading1 style.

negative.description: Word in Chat handles document editing and export. Email delivery uses a separate email service or the user's mail app. Ask for the recipient and exported copy when needed. Make no Word tool call for email delivery, keep the document unchanged, and claim delivery only after a separate email service confirms it.
negative.prompt: Email the open document to my accountant.

negative.description: Software purchases use the vendor's checkout or a separate purchasing service. Word in Chat makes no purchasing call and leaves the document unchanged. Explain what the user needs to do next and claim a purchase only after a separate service confirms it.
negative.prompt: Buy a Microsoft 365 subscription for me.

negative.description: Drive account searches use a separate connected Drive service. If that service is available, ChatGPT may use it. Otherwise, explain that a Drive connection or selected file is needed. Word in Chat makes no account-discovery call and leaves the open document unchanged.
negative.prompt: Find all the Word documents in my Google Drive account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is available without payments.

publication.release_notes: Expose each document edit as an individual tool with its description, input schema, and annotations. Give the uploaded-file and host-file openers distinct display names. Keep the compact project-and-patch path for wording edits.
